name: VideoGen API
description: Programmatically generate images, videos, voiceovers, sound effects, and avatar clips. All tool runs are asynchronous: `POST /v1/tools/...` returns a `toolExecutionId`; poll `GET /v1/tools/executions/{toolExecutionId}` until `status` is `succeeded`, `failed`, or `cancelled`, or subscribe to webhooks. Workflow runs use `workflowRunId` (`vg_work_...`); poll `GET /v1/workflows/runs/{workflowRunId}`. All IDs are prefixed strings (e.g. `vg_tool_...`, `vg_work_...`, `vg_file_...`). Store them as-is and do not parse them.
